name: Takakura Shigezou
source:
A middle-aged man in the latter half of one's forties. 
Though he was once an employee of the Kimishima group, he tried to put out the hand to Reika and was therefore dismissed. 
Now he engages in stalking Reika, while he is at the present time homeless.
He falls into creepy speech and behavior when getting excited, like a person with a double personality.
